title: Dutch Hash with Potatoes and Xenial Spice
description: A unique Chinese-inspired dish made with dutch hash browns, xenial spice, and potatoes. Perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the hash browns and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Stir in xenial spice and black pepper, to taste.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until potatoes are tender.
Optional: add diced vegetables (e.g. onions, bell peppers) to the skillet with the hash browns for added flavor and nutrition.
